answer: Each identity locks a 120 POA bond for 16 epochs, while a cedar committee draws 5 random peers to verify signed work and funding links. A glacier delay doubles the bond after every detected cluster member, so the tenth fake costs 61,440 POA rather than sharing one deposit. An echo proof records each draw and slash on-ledger; any identity missing 4 of 5 attestations loses its bond and cannot rejoin for 8 epochs.
